2b2(rgyud): bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs pa dang /de bzhin du yid mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas shis bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grags kyi chos ston to//de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas/lus 
2b3(rgyud): dang ngag dang yid mnyam pa nyid kyi bkod pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ting nge 'dzin thob pa dang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par

2b5(rgyud): ngag dang yid kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas bkod pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grang kyi chos ston pa dag mthong ngo//de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang la la dag/me tog gi gzhi'i 
2b6(rgyud): snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa/'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams du ma nges par ston pa 'di na byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang spyod pa la nan tan byed pa dang /sa bsgrub pa dang byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 
2b7(rgyud): sangs rgyas pa dang /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa de thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis so//mdor na sems

3a3(rgyud): yang rgyu de nyid dang dmigs ba de nyid kyis so//de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar du gyur cing /ya mtshan gyis 'dun pa'i snying du gyur nas/de bzhin gshegs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo//snyam ste ci de mi

3b1(rgyud): ma yin no//de ru de la dpa' po che//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog/yid gnyis so nyi spangs pa'o//dogs pa gcod pa blta bar gyis//zhes bskul to//de nas 'od zer de dag gis byang

3b7(rgyud): rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la blta ba dang /phyag bgyi ba'i slad du rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi khang pa chen por mchin/rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi khang ba chen po de ni 'jig rten gyi khams gang zhig na mchis/gang du bcom

4a1(rgyud): @#//de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/rang rang gi byang chub sems dpa' de dag la bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu dag 'jig rten gyi khams
